label: [M] measured unless a field says [S] or [A]

readBack.error: affinity is not read on the Windows host (docs/BENCHMARK_POLICY.md host rule)

anvilNode.note: Anvil was started by the unpinned parent process, so the ledger node is not confined to the verifier's core

readBack.error: affinity is not read on the Windows host (docs/BENCHMARK_POLICY.md host rule)

pinning.deviation: native Windows host (DECISIONS D-001): not pinned (docs/BENCHMARK_POLICY.md allows only the power-state query as a Windows call); the pinned series runs on Linux with taskset -c 0 and /proc/<pid>/status

setup.chain: Anvil, automine, started by the parent process
setup.sessionStore: the verifier's own VerifierSessionStore (TTL on the verifier's clock, which does not move during the run); the cached-reads verifier shares it
setup.sessionReuse: the open-session map is copied before the first pass and put back after each pass, so every variant verifies the same P replies as fresh sessions

variants.asShipped: LedgerV4 as shipped: ethers JsonRpcProvider with its default batchStallTime (10 ms per request batch)
variants.noBatchStall: same verifier; the harness sets the provider's batchStallTime to 0 for this pass (client setting, not package code)
variants.cachedReads: every LedgerV4 read served from an in-memory cache after its first call (isolates the non-chain cost)

split.chainMs: outermost LedgerV4 reads (timed by a Proxy on the instance)
split.mlDsaMs: node:crypto verify with an ML-DSA-44 key plus the ML-DSA public-key import (pqc.ts mlDsaVerify), hooked on the node:crypto module object
split.otherMs: the rest: Groth16 verify, Poseidon hashing (issuerKeyHash, policyHash, stmtCode), AES-GCM, JSON and checks [S] by subtraction

isolatedComponents.note: run after the passes on the same P presentations, same process and pinning; snarkjs.groth16.verify is the call the verifier makes
